Feature: Doorstop Requirements Management

  Scenario: Secure storage of requirements
  Given the Doorstop system is initialized
  When a requirement is stored
  Then it should be saved in a permanent and secure manner

  Scenario Outline: Scalability of requirements storage
  Given the Doorstop system is initialized with <N> requirements
  When a new requirement is added
  Then the system should handle <M> requirements

  Examples:
    | N   | M   |
    | 100 | 101 |
    | 1000 | 1001 |
    | 10000 | 10001 |

  Scenario: Change management of requirements
  Given the Doorstop system has existing requirements
  When a requirement change is submitted
  Then it should be associated with the correct developer

  Scenario Outline: Lightweight installation
  Given the Doorstop system is not installed
  When the installation process is initiated
  Then it should complete in a lightweight manner

  Examples:
    | Installation Time |
    | 5 minutes |
    | 10 minutes |
    | 15 minutes |

expected: Requirement is saved in a permanent and secure manner
